intro.en: I am an undergraduate at Shanghai Jiao Tong University and a member of the Zhiyuan Honors Program. I am currently a research intern at MemTensor, mentored by Juncheng Zhang (Tsinghua University). Previously, I worked with Prof. Xuanhe Zhou at Theseus Lab.
intro.zh: 我目前就读于上海交通大学计算机学院，是致远荣誉计划成员。目前在 MemTensor 担任研究实习生，导师为 Juncheng Zhang（清华大学）；此前在 Theseus Lab 跟随周煊赫教授开展研究。

intro.en: My research centers on coding foundation models, long-horizon agents, and self-improving AI. I study how models and agents accumulate, update, and reuse experience, with a focus on agent memory, parametric memory, coding-model post-training, and recursive self-improvement. My background in database systems led me to approach memory from a data-management perspective.
intro.zh: 我的研究兴趣主要是代码基础模型、长程智能体与自我改进 AI，关注模型与智能体如何在长期交互中积累、更新和复用经验。当前重点包括智能体记忆、参数记忆、代码模型后训练与递归自我改进。数据库系统的研究背景，也让我习惯从数据管理的角度理解记忆。

text.en: MemTrace, our work on state-consistent memory for coding agents, is on arXiv. Under review at ICLR 2027.
text.zh: 面向代码智能体的状态一致性记忆工作 MemTrace 已发布于 arXiv，目前在 ICLR 2027 审稿中。

text.en: Joined MemTensor to work on coding-model post-training and long-horizon agent memory.
text.zh: 加入 MemTensor，研究代码模型后训练与长程智能体记忆。

text.en: Are We Ready For An Agent-Native Memory System? is available on arXiv.
text.zh: Are We Ready For An Agent-Native Memory System? 已发布于 arXiv。

publications.title: MemTrace: State-Consistent Memory for Long-Horizon Coding Agents
publications.image_alt: MemTrace overview: execution history becomes immutable memory traces, which are aligned with the evolving repository and checked before reuse.

summary.en: Keeping memory useful as code changes. MemTrace connects immutable execution traces with the current repository state, checking historical evidence before reuse. Evaluated on three software-engineering benchmarks and two coding-agent harnesses.
summary.zh: 让记忆随代码演化保持有效。MemTrace 将不可变的执行轨迹与当前仓库状态关联，在复用历史证据前检查其有效性，并在三个软件工程基准、两种代码智能体框架上进行评测。

contribution.en: Led the design and development of the state-consistent memory system, including structured execution traces, repository grounding, and evaluation against native memory strategies.
contribution.zh: 主导状态一致性记忆系统的设计与开发，包括结构化执行轨迹、仓库状态关联，以及与原生记忆策略的对照评测。

publications.title: Dial: A Knowledge-Grounded Dialect-Specific NL2SQL System
publications.image_alt: Dial framework: dialect-aware logical planning and adaptive query refinement grounded in a hierarchical dialect knowledge base.

summary.en: Knowledge-grounded SQL generation across database dialects. Dial combines dialect-aware logical planning, retrieval from HINT-KB, and execution feedback with semantic correction.
summary.zh: 面向不同数据库方言的知识增强 SQL 生成。Dial 结合方言感知逻辑规划、HINT-KB 知识检索，以及执行反馈和语义修正，支持跨数据库的自然语言查询。

contribution.en: Contributed to natural-language preprocessing, dialect-aware logical planning, HINT-KB design and initialization, dataset preparation, iterative feedback, semantic correction, and failure analysis.
contribution.zh: 参与自然语言预处理、方言感知逻辑规划、HINT-KB 设计与初始化、数据集准备、迭代反馈、语义修正及失败分析。

publications.title: Are We Ready For An Agent-Native Memory System?
publications.image_alt: Four representative agent memory workflows: streaming logs, hierarchical tiers, knowledge graphs, and hybrid multi-engine memory systems.

figure_caption.zh: 图 1 · 智能体记忆工作流

summary.en: A systematic study of agent memory through a data-management lens: representation and storage, extraction, retrieval, and maintenance. We evaluate effectiveness, retrieval fidelity, update robustness, long-term stability, and runtime cost.
summary.zh: 从数据管理视角系统研究智能体记忆，覆盖表示与存储、提取、检索和维护，并评估任务效果、检索保真度、动态更新鲁棒性、长期稳定性及运行成本。

contribution.en: Contributed to the decomposition of memory systems, systematic evaluation across diverse workloads, and experimental analysis of retrieval, updates, stability, and cost.
contribution.zh: 参与记忆系统模块划分、跨工作负载的系统评测，以及检索、更新、稳定性与成本的实验分析。

additional_publication.title: Tensor-Network Physical Pages for Quantum-Ready Data Management

summary.en: TN-Page explores tensor-network physical pages for approximate data management and quantum backends. Contributed to workload-aware bucketization, tensorization, factorization, backend-aware encoding, and evaluation.
summary.zh: TN-Page 探索面向近似数据管理与量子后端的张量网络物理页。参与工作负载感知分桶、张量化、分解、后端感知编码及评测。

mentor.zh: 导师：Juncheng Zhang · 清华大学

description.en: Coding-oriented post-training of the 284B-parameter DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 model: software-engineering task synthesis, training data and trajectory curation, and checkpoint evaluation. Led MemTrace and research on reliable memory for long-horizon coding agents.
description.zh: 参与 284B 参数 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 模型的代码后训练，包括软件工程任务合成、训练数据与执行轨迹筛选、模型评测。主导 MemTrace，研究长程代码智能体中历史证据的可靠复用。

experience.organization: Shanghai Jiao Tong University · Theseus Lab

description.en: Worked on dialect-aware NL2SQL with Dial and HINT-KB, then extended this data-management perspective to agent memory through Are We Ready For An Agent-Native Memory System?.
description.zh: 参与 Dial 与 HINT-KB 的方言感知 NL2SQL 研究，随后通过 Are We Ready For An Agent-Native Memory System? 将数据管理视角拓展到智能体记忆。
